component.name: Calculator
component.summary: Calculator with standard and scientific modes

description.p: A GTK 4 calculator with a Material 3 Expressive style. It takes its colours from the desktop or from a palette you choose.

ul.li: Live result preview, history and keyboard input
Built-in palettes, a custom accent colour or a palette file

screenshot.caption: Scientific mode with a preset palette

description.p: Starts about four times faster, remembers its position, keeps its proportions when resized, and opens smaller.
The window size is remembered on Hyprland.
Switching modes keeps the window size you set, and small windows stay small.
Rust only, a window that scales down to about half size, and a smoother shrink on Hyprland.
Closing scientific mode without stretched keys, and with a smooth shrink.

ul.li: On Hyprland, the window shrinks without the compositor's animation when scientific mode closes, so the keys no longer look stretched
The minimize, maximize and close buttons show one round shape instead of a pill around the theme's own circle

description.p: Smoother scientific mode and an optional Rust version.

ul.li: Closing scientific mode no longer stretches the keys
A Rust version that looks and works the same, installed with ./install.sh --rust

description.p: The app opens from launchers that do not have ~/.local/bin in their PATH.
Decimal separator setting and calculation fixes.

ul.li: New setting: point or comma as the decimal symbol
Pressing = again repeats the right operation after E notation or a negative number
Results reused in a new calculation keep their full precision
Pasting handles exp, Ans, mod and thousands separators
tan at 90° is reported as undefined in radians too
